text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim that self-driving cars would \"greatly decrease the amount of accidents\"","quality":"explicit thesis","description":"The essay states a clear position early and makes the argument it will defend obvious to the reader."},{"evidence":"paragraphs explaining accidents, money, gas use, and greenhouse gases","quality":"reasoned support","description":"The essay develops its stance with multiple linked reasons instead of mostly listing facts."},{"evidence":"\"This means a large decrease in people injured\" and \"This could also save people money\"","quality":"argumentative elaboration","description":"The essay explains the significance of evidence by spelling out consequences for people and society."},{"evidence":"opening hook and concluding wrap-up","quality":"essay organization","description":"The essay has a more recognizable introduction, body development, and conclusion than the other response."},{"evidence":"readable sentence flow despite errors","quality":"coherence","description":"The ideas generally connect from one sentence to the next in a way that is easier to follow overall."}]}
